tools.name: get_workspace_info
tools.description: Return workspace metadata, configured folders, compiler availability, permissions and community account.

schema_version.description: Version of this tool result schema.

include_folder.description: Main MQL5 include/search folder used to resolve source and include files.

current_folder.description: Current workspace folder for relative paths and default file operations.

shared_projects_folder.description: MetaEditor Shared Projects folder connected to Algo Forge storage.

permissions.description: Filesystem permissions exposed by MCP tools.

read_roots.description: Directories that MCP tools are allowed to read.

write_roots.description: Directories that MCP tools are allowed to modify or create files in.

can_create_files.description: Whether file creation tools may create new files under write_roots.

can_modify_files.description: Whether write and patch tools may modify existing files under write_roots.

compiler.description: Configured compiler and helper toolchain availability.

compiler_mql5.description: Whether the native MQL5 compiler is available.

compiler_mql5_target.description: Default MQL5 compiler target architecture or instruction set.

compiler_python.description: Whether a Python runtime is configured for helper scripts or analysis tools.

compiler_python_folder.description: Folder that contains the configured Python runtime, when compiler_python is true.

compiler_visual_studio.description: Whether Microsoft Visual C++ tools are configured for native helper builds.

compiler_visual_studio_folder.description: Folder that contains the configured Visual Studio toolchain, when compiler_visual_studio is true.

compiler_windows_sdk_folder.description: Windows SDK folder paired with the configured MSVC toolchain.

community_login.description: MQL5.community login of active user, if available.

ide.description: MetaEditor user interface and editor settings.

can_compile_file.description: Whether compile_file can compile one MQL5 source file.

can_compile_project.description: Whether compile_project can compile an existing MetaEditor project.

can_run_backtest.description: Whether strategy tester tools can run backtests in this environment.

can_run_optimization.description: Whether strategy tester tools can run optimization in this environment.

can_read_terminal_journal.description: Whether terminal journal logs can be read through MCP tools.

can_read_expert_journal.description: Whether expert journal logs can be read through MCP tools.

can_read_tester_journal.description: Whether tester journal logs can be read through MCP tools.

limits.description: Default operational limits for MCP tools.

max_read_file_bytes.description: Default maximum bytes returned by read_file in one call.

max_search_results.description: Default maximum number of results returned by search tools.

max_directory_tree_depth.description: Default maximum traversal depth for list_directory_tree.

tools.name: get_time_information
tools.description: Get current time information from the connected MetaTrader 5 terminal and the local computer. Returns UTC/GMT time, local computer time, local time offset from UTC in minutes, daylight saving time status, calculated trade server time, and last known server time if available. This tool is read-only and never places, modifies or cancels orders.

tools.name: list_directory
tools.description: List files and directories under a workspace directory, with optional traversal depth and hidden-entry controls.

path.description: Absolute directory path to inspect. The path must be under an allowed read root returned by get_workspace_info. Do not pass relative paths.

max_depth.description: Maximum traversal depth. Use 0 to return only the root node.

show_hidden.description: Include hidden and system entries when available.

tools.name: find_files_by_glob
tools.description: Find files and directories whose paths match a glob pattern relative to a selected root directory.

path.description: Absolute directory path where the search starts. The path must be under an allowed read root returned by get_workspace_info. Do not pass relative paths.

pattern.description: Glob pattern to match, for example **/*.mq5 or Include/**/*.mqh.

max_results.description: Maximum number of matching paths to return.

show_hidden.description: Include hidden and system files in the search.

tools.name: find_files_by_name_keyword
tools.description: Find files by filename keyword when the exact path is unknown.

path.description: Absolute directory path to inspect. The path must be under an allowed read root returned by get_workspace_info. Do not pass relative paths.

keyword.description: Filename fragment to find. Matching is case-insensitive unless case_sensitive is true.

max_results.description: Maximum number of matching paths to return.

tools.name: read_file
tools.description: Read text or bytes from a workspace file, optionally limited to a byte range. Text encoding is automatically detected.

path.description: Absolute file path to read. The path must be under an allowed read root returned by get_workspace_info. Do not pass relative paths.

offset.description: Zero-based byte offset where reading starts.

length.description: Maximum number of bytes to read.

tools.name: read_binary_file
tools.description: Read binary bytes from a workspace file, optionally limited to a byte range.

path.description: Absolute file path to read. The path must be under an allowed read root returned by get_workspace_info. Do not pass relative paths.

offset.description: Zero-based byte offset where reading starts.

length.description: Maximum number of bytes to read. Use 0 to read all remaining bytes from the specified offset to the end of the file.

tools.name: read_file_by_lines
tools.description: Read selected lines from a text workspace file. Line numbers are 1-based; start_line and end_line define an inclusive range. An optional encoding hint may be provided.

path.description: Absolute file path to read. The path must be under an allowed read root returned by get_workspace_info. Do not pass relative paths.

start_line.description: 1-based line number where reading starts. Defaults to 1.

end_line.description: 1-based inclusive line number where reading ends. If omitted, reads to the end of file or max_lines limit.

max_lines.description: Maximum number of lines to return. Defaults to a safe server-defined limit.

encoding.description: Text encoding hint: auto, utf-8, utf-8-bom, utf-16le, utf-16le-bom, cp1251, windows-1251, ansi, or oem. Defaults to auto.

tools.name: create_new_folder
tools.description: Create a new workspace folder.

path.description: Absolute folder path to create. The path must be under an allowed write root returned by get_workspace_info. Do not pass relative paths. Parent directories will be created automatically.

tools.name: create_new_file
tools.description: Create a new workspace file with optional initial content and overwrite protection.

path.description: Absolute file path to create. The path must be under an allowed write root returned by get_workspace_info. Do not pass relative paths. Parent directories will be created automatically.

content.description: Initial file content. Defaults to an empty file.

encoding.description: Text encoding to use when content is provided.

overwrite.description: Allow replacing an existing file when true.

bom.description: Write UTF BOM when supported by encoding. Defaults to false.

tools.name: write_file
tools.description: Replace the full content of a workspace file, with optional directory creation, encoding, and overwrite control.

path.description: Absolute file path to create. The path must be under an allowed write root returned by get_workspace_info. Do not pass relative paths. Parent directories will be created automatically.

content.description: Complete content that should replace the file body.

encoding.description: Text encoding to use for writing.

overwrite.description: Allow replacing an existing file when true.

bom.description: Write UTF BOM when supported by encoding. Defaults to false.

tools.name: write_binary_file
tools.description: Write binary data to a workspace file using hex encoded input, with auto directory creation, overwrite control and offset writing.

path.description: Absolute file path to create. The path must be under an allowed write root returned by get_workspace_info. Do not pass relative paths. Parent directories will be created automatically.

offset.description: Optional zero-based byte offset to write at. If omitted, the full file is replaced or created.

overwrite.description: Allow replacing an existing file when true. Defaults to false.

truncate.description: When offset is used, truncate the file after the written data. Defaults to false.

tools.name: delete_file
tools.description: Delete a single workspace file. The path must resolve under an allowed write root. Does not delete folders, wildcards, or files outside the workspace.

path.description: Absolute file path to delete. The path must be under an allowed write root returned by get_workspace_info. Do not pass relative paths.

missing_ok.description: Treat a missing file as a successful no-op. Defaults to false.

tools.name: delete_folder
tools.description: Delete a workspace folder. The path must resolve under an allowed write root. By default, only an empty folder can be deleted. Set recursive to true to delete the folder and all of its contents.

path.description: Absolute path of the folder to delete. The path must be under an allowed write root returned by get_workspace_info. Do not pass relative paths.

recursive.description: Delete all files and subfolders before deleting the target folder. When false, deletion fails if the folder is not empty.

missing_ok.description: Treat a missing folder as a successful no-op. Defaults to false.

tools.name: replace_text_in_file
tools.description: Replace literal case-sensitive text within a single line of a file while preserving the rest of the file unchanged. Multiline search is not supported: search must not contain carriage-return or newline characters. Use start_line and end_line only to restrict the range of lines inspected.

path.description: Absolute file path where text replacement should be performed. The path must be under an allowed write root returned by get_workspace_info. Do not pass relative paths.

search.description: Literal case-sensitive single-line text to find. Must not contain carriage-return or newline characters. Multiline matching is not supported.

start_line.description: Optional 1-based line number where replacement starts. Does not enable matching across line boundaries. If omitted, replacement starts at the beginning of the file.

end_line.description: Optional 1-based inclusive line number where replacement ends. Does not enable matching across line boundaries. If omitted, replacement continues to the end of the file.

all.description: Replace all occurrences instead of only the first match. Defaults to true.

tools.name: search_text
tools.description: Search workspace files for literal text and return file locations with matching lines.

path.description: Absolute directory path where the search starts. The path must be under an allowed read root returned by get_workspace_info. Do not pass relative paths.

file_glob.description: Glob filter limiting files included in the search.

max_results.description: Maximum number of matches to return.

tools.name: search_regex
tools.description: Search workspace files with a regular expression and return file locations with matching lines.

path.description: Absolute directory path where the search starts. The path must be under an allowed read root returned by get_workspace_info. Do not pass relative paths.

pattern.description: Regular expression pattern to search for. PCRE2 syntax is supported. Escape backslashes according to JSON string rules.

file_glob.description: Glob filter limiting files included in the search.

max_results.description: Maximum number of matches to return.

tools.name: send_web_request
tools.description: Send one outbound HTTP or HTTPS request and return the HTTP response status, headers and response body or output file metadata. The url must be an absolute http:// or https:// URL. Headers must be CRLF-separated 'Name: Value' lines without the request line and without the final empty CRLF. For request bodies, use body_format: none for no body, utf-8 to send body as UTF-8 text bytes, hex to decode body as raw bytes from hexadecimal, or file to send the raw content of input_filename. Exactly one request body source is allowed: body for utf-8/hex, input_filename for file, or no body for none. If output_filename is provided, save the response body to that file and return metadata instead of returning the full body inline. For HEAD requests, return headers only. This tool performs network I/O only and never places, modifies or cancels trading orders.

method.description: HTTP method: GET, POST, PUT, PATCH, DELETE, HEAD or OPTIONS.

url.description: Absolute HTTP or HTTPS target URL.

headers.description: Optional HTTP request headers as CRLF-separated 'Name: Value' lines. Do not include the request line or the final empty CRLF.

body_format.description: Optional request body format/source: none, utf-8, hex or file. Default is none. Use utf-8 when body contains text to send as UTF-8 bytes. Use hex when body contains hexadecimal bytes. Use file when the request body must be read from input_filename.

body.description: Optional request body. Required when body_format is utf-8 or hex. For body_format=utf-8, body is textual content encoded as UTF-8 bytes. For body_format=hex, body must contain only hexadecimal digits, without 0x prefix, spaces or separators.

input_filename.description: Optional input file name used as the raw request body when body_format is file. Required only when body_format is file. The file content is sent as-is without text conversion.

output_filename.description: Optional output file name for saving the HTTP response body instead of returning it inline. Use for large or binary responses. Parent directories will be created automatically.

tools.name: chart_open
tools.description: Open new MetaTrader 5 chart by exact symbol name and period.

symbol.description: Exact symbol name for the chart to open, for example EURUSD, XAUUSD or AAPL depending on the broker symbol set. The symbol must be available in the connected terminal.

period.description: Chart period: M1, M2, M3, M4, M5, M6, M10, M12, M15, M20, M30, H1, H2, H3, H4, H6, H8, H12, D1, W1, MN1.

tools.name: chart_close
tools.description: Close MetaTrader 5 chart by exact chart_id.

chart_id.description: Chart id received on chart_open or list_open_charts.

tools.name: chart_apply_template
tools.description: Apply template for existing MetaTrader 5 chart by exact chart_id and name of existing template file. Explicitly state which chart properties, objects, indicators and Expert Advisors are replaced, retained or added. If a template can attach an EA, treat this operation as potentially capable of initiating real trading.

chart_id.description: Chart id received on chart_open or list_open_charts.

template_filename.description: The name of the file containing the template. The file must exist in the folder \MQL5\Profiles\Templates

tools.name: chart_add_indicator
tools.description: Add one standard or custom indicator to an existing MetaTrader 5 chart identified by chart_id. For a standard indicator, provide indicator_name and omit custom_indicator_path. For a custom indicator, provide indicator_name and custom_indicator_path; the compiled .ex5 file must exist under the MQL5 directory. Indicator inputs can be supplied through indicator_parameters as a strict comma-separated Name=Value string. Do not include spaces. Use exact input names with the correct letter case, represent enum values by their numeric codes, use a dot as the decimal separator, and do not specify the same parameter more than once. This tool modifies the selected chart but never places, modifies or cancels trading orders.

chart_id.description: Chart id received on chart_open or list_open_charts.

indicator_parameters.description: Optional indicator inputs formatted as a strict comma-separated list of Name=Value pairs. Do not use spaces. For custom indicators, parameter names must exactly match the mql5 input variable names declared by the indicator. Invalid parameters may be silently ignored, converted to zero or replaced with defaults

indicator_name.description: Exact indicator name. For a standard indicator, use its standard name and omit custom_indicator_path. For a custom indicator, use its display name and also provide custom_indicator_path.

custom_indicator_path.description: Absolute path to the compiled custom indicator file (.ex5), normally located under the terminal's MQL5 directory. Required only for custom indicators. Omit this parameter for standard indicators.

tools.name: chart_add_expert
tools.description: Add one expert advisor to an existing MetaTrader 5 chart identified by chart_id. Replaces any expert advisor already attached to the chart. The compiled .ex5 file must exist under the MQL5 directory. Expert advisor inputs can be supplied through expert_parameters as a strict comma-separated Name=Value string. Do not include spaces. Use exact input names with the correct letter case, represent enum values by their numeric codes, use a dot as the decimal separator, and do not specify the same parameter more than once.

chart_id.description: Chart id received on chart_open or list_open_charts.

expert_path.description: Absolute path to mql5 program file (.ex5). The path must be under an allowed read root returned by get_workspace_info.

expert_parameters.description: Optional expert advisor inputs formatted as a strict comma-separated list of Name=Value pairs. Do not use spaces. Parameter names must exactly match the mql5 input variable names declared by the program. Invalid parameters may be silently ignored, converted to zero or replaced with defaults

tools.name: chart_add_script
tools.description: Execute one compiled script on an existing MetaTrader 5 chart identified by chart_id. The compiled .ex5 file must exist under the MQL5 directory. Script inputs can be supplied through script_parameters as a strict comma-separated Name=Value string. Do not include spaces. Use exact input names with the correct letter case, represent enum values by their numeric codes, use a dot as the decimal separator, and do not specify the same parameter more than once.

chart_id.description: Chart id received on chart_open or list_open_charts.

script_path.description: Absolute path to mql5 program file (.ex5). The path must be under an allowed read root returned by get_workspace_info.

script_parameters.description: Optional script inputs formatted as a strict comma-separated list of Name=Value pairs. Do not use spaces. Parameter names must exactly match the mql5 input variable names declared by the program. Invalid parameters may be silently ignored, converted to zero or replaced with defaults

tools.name: chart_remove_expert
tools.description: Remove expert advisor from an existing MetaTrader 5 chart identified by chart_id.

chart_id.description: Chart id received on chart_open or list_open_charts.

tools.name: chart_remove_indicator
tools.description: Remove one standard or custom indicator from an existing MetaTrader 5 chart identified by chart_id. Provide exact, case-sensitive short name of the attached indicator and zero-based subwindow number.

chart_id.description: Chart id received on chart_open or list_open_charts.

window.description: Zero-based chart subwindow containing the indicator. Copy this value from the indicator’s window field in list_open_charts. Use 0 for the main chart window. The correct window is required even when the short_name is otherwise valid. Subwindow indices may change after an indicator from a non-main chart window is removed.

short_name.description: Case-sensitive exact short_name returned by list_open_charts. Do not use the catalog indicator name.

tools.name: chart_get_indicator_state
tools.description: Returns the configuration and current runtime state of an indicator attached to an open MetaTrader 5 chart, including its inputs and visible buffer values ordered from oldest to newest (last element is the newest value and represents the last visible chart bar). For shifted plots, the last element may correspond to a future display position rather than the last market bar. Identify the indicator by the exact case-sensitive short_name and zero-based subwindow number from list_open_charts.

chart_id.description: Chart id received on chart_open or list_open_charts.

window.description: Zero-based chart subwindow containing the indicator. Copy this value from the indicator’s window field in list_open_charts. Use 0 for the main chart window. The correct window is required even when the short_name is otherwise valid.

short_name.description: Case-sensitive exact short_name returned by list_open_charts. Do not use the catalog indicator name.

tools.name: list_open_charts
tools.description: List currently open MetaTrader 5 charts. For each chart, includes a list of indicators, expert advisors/robots and metadata.

tools.name: list_available_indicators
tools.description: List indicators available to the connected MetaTrader 5 terminal. Returns built-in standard indicators and compiled custom indicators found under the MQL5 directory, filtered by indicator_type when specified. This tool lists available indicators; it does not list indicators currently attached to charts.

filter.description: Optional case-insensitive substring filter applied to the indicator name. If omitted, all available indicators are returned.

indicator_type.description: Optional indicator source filter: all, custom or standard. Defaults to all.

tools.name: list_available_mql5_programs
tools.description: List mql5 programs available to the connected MetaTrader 5 terminal. Returns standard programs included with the terminal and compiled custom programs found under the MQL5 directory, filtered by program_type when specified. This tool reports program availability, not runtime or chart attachment state.

filter.description: Optional case-insensitive substring filter applied to the program name. If omitted, all available programs are returned.

program_type.description: Optional mql5 program filter: all, expert, script or service. Defaults to all.

tools.name: get_expert_advisor_parameters
tools.description: Get the parameters of a specified expert advisor. The parameters array preserves declaration order and contains each parameter index, canonical name, MQL type and string default value. Input groups are returned with type group.

expert_path.description: Absolute path to mql5 program file (.ex5). The path must be under an allowed read root returned by get_workspace_info.

tools.name: get_script_parameters
tools.description: Get the parameters of a specified script. The parameters array preserves declaration order and contains each parameter index, canonical name, MQL type and string default value. Input groups are returned with type group.

script_path.description: Absolute path to mql5 program file (.ex5). The path must be under an allowed read root returned by get_workspace_info.

tools.name: get_indicator_parameters
tools.description: Get the parameters of a specified indicator. The parameters object contains string default values keyed by canonical parameter names accepted directly by chart_add_indicator.

indicator_name.description: Exact indicator name returned by list_available_indicators. For a standard indicator, use its standard name and omit custom_indicator_path. For a custom indicator, use its display name and also provide custom_indicator_path.

custom_indicator_path.description: Absolute path to the compiled custom indicator file (.ex5), normally located under the terminal's MQL5 directory. Required only for custom indicators. Omit this parameter for standard indicators.

tools.name: get_trading_account_info
tools.description: Get trading account information from the connected MetaTrader 5 terminal account. This tool is read-only and never places, modifies or cancels orders.

tools.name: get_trading_history_positions
tools.description: Get trading history of positions from the connected MetaTrader 5 terminal account for a datetime range. Optionally filter by exact symbol name. Returns aggregated historical trading positions reconstructed from deals. This tool is read-only and never places, modifies or cancels orders.

datetime_from.description: Inclusive start time as ISO datetime.

datetime_to.description: Exclusive end time as ISO datetime. Must be greater than datetime_from.

symbol.description: Optional exact MetaTrader symbol filter. Matching is case-insensitive and does not use wildcards or partial matching.

limit.description: Maximum number of records to return. 100000 by default.

tools.name: get_trading_history_orders
tools.description: Get trading history of orders from the connected MetaTrader 5 terminal account for a datetime range. Optionally filter by exact symbol name. Returns historical orders, deals, execution details, prices, volumes, profit, commission, swap and fees. This tool is read-only and never places, modifies or cancels orders.

datetime_from.description: Inclusive start time as ISO datetime.

datetime_to.description: Exclusive end time as ISO datetime. Must be greater than datetime_from.

symbol.description: Optional exact MetaTrader symbol filter. Matching is case-insensitive and does not use wildcards or partial matching.

include_orders.description: Include historical orders in the response. True by default.

include_orders_canceled.description: Include canceled historical orders in the response. False by default.

include_deals.description: Include historical deals in the response. True by default.

limit.description: Maximum number of records to return. 100000 by default.

tools.name: get_trading_open_positions
tools.description: Get currently open trading positions and orders from the connected MetaTrader 5 terminal account. Optionally filter by exact symbol name. Returns detailed information about open positions and orders, including symbol, volume, price, profit, and other relevant data. This tool is read-only and never places, modifies or cancels orders.

include_orders.description: Include orders in the response. True by default.

symbol.description: Optional exact MetaTrader symbol filter. Matching is case-insensitive and does not use wildcards or partial matching.

tools.name: get_marketwatch_symbols
tools.description: Get the list of symbols currently available in the Market Watch window of the connected MetaTrader 5 terminal. Optionally filter by exact symbol name. Returns detailed information about each symbol, including name, description, and trading conditions. This tool is read-only and never places, modifies or cancels orders.

symbol.description: Optional exact MetaTrader symbol filter. Matching is case-insensitive and does not use wildcards or partial matching.

include_hidden.description: Include symbols hidden from Market Watch. When enabled without an exact symbol filter, the response is returned in catalog mode and does not include current quote fields. An exact visible-symbol lookup may still include current quotes. False by default.

limit.description: Maximum number of records to return. 1000 by default.

tools.name: add_marketwatch_symbol
tools.description: Add an exact symbol name to the Market Watch window of the connected MetaTrader 5 terminal. This changes Market Watch visibility only; it never places, modifies, or cancels orders.

symbol.description: Exact symbol name to add to the Market Watch window, for example EURUSD, XAUUSD or AAPL depending on the broker symbol set.

show.description: Show the symbol in Market Watch after adding it. Defaults to true.

tools.name: remove_marketwatch_symbol
tools.description: Remove an exact symbol name from the Market Watch window of the connected MetaTrader 5 terminal. This tool modifies only the local Market Watch symbol list and never places, modifies, or cancels orders.

symbol.description: Exact symbol name to remove from the Market Watch window, for example EURUSD, XAUUSD or AAPL depending on the broker symbol set.

tools.name: get_chart_history
tools.description: Get historical chart data for a specified symbol and timeframe from the connected MetaTrader 5 terminal for a datetime range. Returns detailed information about each candlestick, including open, high, low, close, and volume. This tool is read-only and never places, modifies or cancels orders.

datetime_from.description: Inclusive start time as ISO datetime.

datetime_to.description: Exclusive end time as ISO datetime. Must be greater than datetime_from.

symbol.description: Exact MetaTrader symbol filter. Matching is case-insensitive and does not use wildcards or partial matching.

period.description: Chart period: M1, M2, M3, M4, M5, M6, M10, M12, M15, M20, M30, H1, H2, H3, H4, H6, H8, H12, D1, W1, MN1.

limit.description: Maximum number of records to return. 100000 by default.

tools.name: get_chart_ticks_history
tools.description: Get historical tick data for a specified symbol from the connected MetaTrader 5 terminal for a datetime range. Returns detailed information about each tick, including time, bid, ask, and optional volume. This tool is read-only and never places, modifies or cancels orders.

datetime_from.description: Inclusive start time as ISO datetime.

datetime_to.description: Exclusive end time as ISO datetime. Must be greater than datetime_from.

symbol.description: Exact MetaTrader symbol filter. Matching is case-insensitive and does not use wildcards or partial matching.

limit.description: Maximum number of records to return. 100000 by default.

tools.name: trade_send_market_order
tools.description: Send one buy or sell market order to the connected MetaTrader 5 terminal, optionally with stop loss and take profit. Use only after an explicit user instruction specifying the symbol, side and volume. Refresh positions and orders before calling this tool. Returns the trading operation result, including tickets and execution details when available. This tool places real trading orders - use with extreme caution.

symbol.description: Exact symbol name from Market Watch, for example EURUSD, XAUUSD or AAPL.

type.description: Market order side: buy or sell. Current market price will be used.

volume.description: Order volume in lots as a decimal number.

sl.description: Optional stop loss price as a decimal number. Omit to place without stop loss.

tp.description: Optional take profit price as a decimal number. Omit to place without take profit.

tools.name: trade_send_pending_order
tools.description: Place one pending order in the connected MetaTrader 5 terminal: buy_limit, sell_limit, buy_stop, sell_stop, buy_stop_limit or sell_stop_limit, optionally with stop loss, take profit and expiration. Use only after an explicit user instruction specifying the symbol, order type, volume and price. Refresh positions and orders before calling this tool. Returns the trading operation result, including tickets and execution details when available. This tool places real trading orders - use with extreme caution.

symbol.description: Exact symbol name from Market Watch, for example EURUSD, XAUUSD or AAPL.

type.description: Pending order type: buy_limit, sell_limit, buy_stop, sell_stop, buy_stop_limit or sell_stop_limit.

volume.description: Order volume in lots as a decimal number.

price.description: Pending order trigger/limit price as a decimal number.

stoplimit.description: Limit order price for buy_stop_limit and sell_stop_limit. Required only for stop-limit pending orders.

sl.description: Optional stop loss price as a decimal number. Omit to place without stop loss.

tp.description: Optional take profit price as a decimal number. Omit to place without take profit.

filling_type.description: Optional filling type: fok, ioc, boc or return. Availability depends on the symbol and execution mode.

expiration_type.description: Optional expiration type: gtc, day, specified, specified_day. Default is gtc.

expiration_time.description: Optional expiration time as ISO 8601 datetime. Required only when expiration_type is specified or specified_day.

tools.name: trade_modify_sl_tp
tools.description: Modify stop loss and/or take profit of one existing position or one existing pending order. Provide either position_ticket or order_ticket, not both. Use only after an explicit user instruction specifying the target ticket and requested SL/TP changes. Refresh positions and orders before calling this tool. Returns the trading operation result. Do not send unchanged SL/TP values, otherwise the server may return a no-changes result. This tool modifies real trading positions or orders - use with extreme caution.

symbol.description: Symbol name used as a safety check. It must match the target position or pending order symbol.

position_ticket.description: Position ticket if it's a position. Provide either position_ticket or order_ticket, not both.

order_ticket.description: Pending order ticket if it's an order. Provide either position_ticket or order_ticket, not both.

sl.description: Optional new stop loss price. Use 0 to remove stop loss. Omit to keep the current stop loss unchanged. Do not pass the current unchanged value.

tp.description: Optional new take profit price. Use 0 to remove take profit. Omit to keep the current take profit unchanged. Do not pass the current unchanged value.

tools.name: trade_delete_order
tools.description: Delete one existing pending order. Use only after an explicit user instruction specifying the order ticket. The symbol argument is used as a safety check and must match the pending order symbol. Refresh positions and orders before calling this tool. Returns the trading operation result. This tool cancels real trading orders - use with extreme caution.

symbol.description: Symbol name used as a safety check. It must match the target pending order symbol.

tools.name: trade_close_single_position
tools.description: Close one existing position by position ticket. Use only after an explicit user instruction specifying the position ticket. The symbol argument is used as a safety check and must match the position symbol. Refresh positions and orders before calling this tool. Returns the trading operation result. This tool closes real trading positions - use with extreme caution.

symbol.description: Symbol name used as a safety check. It must match the target position symbol.

tools.name: trade_close_by_position
tools.description: Close two opposite positions of the same symbol using the close-by operation. This is applicable only when the account and symbol support opposite positions. Use only after an explicit user instruction specifying both position tickets. Refresh positions and orders before calling this tool. Returns the trading operation result. This tool closes real trading positions - use with extreme caution.

symbol.description: Symbol name used as a safety check. Both opposite positions must have this symbol.

position_ticket_by.description: Ticket of the opposite position used for close-by.

tools.name: tester_run_backtest
tools.description: Start a strategy tester backtest from a prepared configuration and return a run identifier.

config_path.description: Absolute path to tester ini configuration file in subfolder \MQL5\Profiles\Tester. Configuration file must contain name of existed ex5 file. The path must be under an allowed read root returned by get_workspace_info.

inputs_path.description: Absolute path to the mql5 program parameter file (.set) in subfolder \MQL5\Profiles\Tester. If specified, instrument loads this file before starting the test. If this parameter is not provided, default settings are used.

wait.description: Wait until the test finishes before returning.

timeout_sec.description: Maximum time, in seconds, to wait for the test to finish when wait is true. If the timeout expires, the tool returns while the test continues running in the background. This parameter does not limit or stop the test and is ignored when wait is false.

tools.name: tester_get_status
tools.description: Return the current status of strategy tester (started or stopped), progress and timing for a running tester job.

run_id.description: Identifier of a tester run returned by tester_run_backtest or tester_run_optimization.

tools.name: tester_stop
tools.description: Stop a running strategy tester job identified by run_id. The operation stops the test or optimization.

run_id.description: Identifier of a tester run returned by tester_run_backtest or tester_run_optimization.

tools.name: tester_wait
tools.description: Wait for a strategy tester job identified by run_id to finish. If the timeout expires before the job finishes, the tool returns without stopping the job, which continues running in the background.

run_id.description: Identifier of a tester run returned by tester_run_backtest or tester_run_optimization.

timeout_sec.description: Maximum time, in seconds, to wait for the tester run to finish. This parameter limits only the wait operation and does not stop the tester run.

tools.name: tester_get_configuration
tools.description: Return strategy tester configuration.

run_id.description: Identifier of a tester run returned by tester_run_backtest or tester_run_optimization.

tools.name: tester_prepare_config
tools.description: Create or update a strategy tester configuration file. If any parameter is omitted, the existing terminal setting / named concrete default is used.

mql5_program_path.description: Absolute path to an existing compiled .ex5 used by the strategy tester. The path must be under an allowed read root returned by get_workspace_info.

model.description: Tick model: every tick, m1 ohlc, open prices, math calculations or real ticks.

timeframe.description: Chart timeframe such as M1, H1, or D1.

optimization_criterion.description: Optimization criterion: balance_max, profit_factor_max, expected_payoff_max, drawdown_min, recovery_factor_max, sharpe_ratio_max, custom_max or metric_max.

from_date.description: Backtest start time as ISO datetime. Testing dates have daily granularity; the time component does not define an intraday boundary. The minimum testing range is one calendar day, so from_date must be earlier than to_date by date.

to_date.description: Backtest end time as ISO datetime. Testing dates have daily granularity; the time component does not define an intraday boundary. to_date must be at least the calendar day following from_date. Intraday testing ranges are not supported.

forward_mode.description: Forward mode: 0 disabled, 1 one half, 2 one third, 3 one quarter, 4 custom date.

forward_date.description: Custom forward start time as ISO datetime. Required when forward_mode is 4.

deposit.description: Initial deposit for the test account.

execution_delay.description: Trade execution delay (0 - no delay, -1 - random delay, other number - delay in ms).

profit_in_pips.description: Use profit in pips mode for faster calculations.

output_path.description: Absolute path to tester ini configuration file in subfolder \MQL5\Profiles\Tester where the generated tester configuration should be written.

tools.name: tester_prepare_inputs
tools.description: Create or update Expert Advisor parameter file (.set) for strategy tester. Validate each parameter against the compiled EA inputs.

mql5_program_path.description: Absolute path to an existing compiled .ex5 used by the strategy tester. The path must be under an allowed read root returned by get_workspace_info.

parameters.description: List of mql5 program inputs in native SET format: name=value or name=value||start||step||stop||Y/N.

output_path.description: Absolute path to the mql5 program parameter file (.set) in subfolder \MQL5\Profiles\Tester where the generated file should be written.

tools.name: tester_get_report
tools.description: Return report for a last completed strategy tester run as json, or save the report as json or xml to a file. When file_format is xml, path is required.

run_id.description: Identifier of a tester run returned by tester_run_backtest or tester_run_optimization.

path.description: Absolute destination path for saving the report. Required when file_format is xml; optional when file_format is json or omitted. The path must be under an allowed write root.

file_format.description: Report format: json or xml. Defaults to json. Report in json can be returned inline when path is omitted. Report in xml is available only as a saved file and requires path. Report in xml include input parameters. For tester_run_backtest the xml format is saved as xlsx.

tools.name: tester_run_optimization
tools.description: Start a strategy tester optimization run from a prepared configuration and return an optimization job identifier.

config_path.description: Absolute path to tester optimization configuration file in subfolder \MQL5\Profiles\Tester.

inputs_path.description: Absolute path to the Expert Advisor parameter file (.set) in subfolder \MQL5\Profiles\Tester. If specified, instrument loads this file before starting the test. If this parameter is not provided, default settings are used.

wait.description: Wait until the optimization finishes before returning.

timeout_sec.description: Maximum time, in seconds, to wait for the optimization to finish when wait is true. If the timeout expires, the tool returns while the optimization continues running in the background. This parameter does not limit or stop the optimization and is ignored when wait is false.

tools.name: get_terminal_journal
tools.description: Read terminal journal records for a required timezone-free local time interval. Filtering precision is one second. Supports a case-sensitive substring filter over source and message and a result limit. Records are returned oldest first; truncated is true when additional matches exist.

datetime_from.description: Inclusive start time filter in ISO format. Use local computer time in the terminal host current time zone.

datetime_to.description: Exclusive end time filter in ISO format. Use local computer time in the terminal host current time zone.

limit.description: Optional maximum number of journal lines to return. Minimal value is 1.

filter.description: Optional case-sensitive substring used to filter journal lines. The value searched in both the source and message fields.

tools.name: get_expert_journal
tools.description: Read journal records produced by MQL5 programs for a required timezone-free local time interval. Filtering precision is one second. Supports case-sensitive source and text filters and a result limit. Records are returned oldest first; truncated is true when additional matches exist.

mql5_program_name.description: Optional case-sensitive substring used to filter journal records by the source field. The value does not need to match the complete mql5 program name.

datetime_from.description: Inclusive start time filter in ISO format. Use local computer time in the terminal host current time zone.

datetime_to.description: Exclusive end time filter in ISO format. Use local computer time in the terminal host current time zone.

limit.description: Optional maximum number of journal lines to return. Minimal value is 1.

filter.description: Optional case-sensitive substring used to filter journal lines. The value searched in both the source and message fields.

tools.name: get_tester_journal
tools.description: Read tester journal records, including main tester and tester-agent sources, for a required timezone-free local time interval. Filtering precision is one second. Supports a case-sensitive substring filter over source and message and a result limit. Records are returned oldest first; truncated is true when additional matches exist.

datetime_from.description: Inclusive start time filter in ISO format. Use local computer time in the terminal host current time zone.

datetime_to.description: Exclusive end time filter in ISO format. Use local computer time in the terminal host current time zone.

limit.description: Optional maximum number of journal lines to return. Minimal value is 1.

filter.description: Optional case-sensitive substring used to filter journal lines. The value searched in both the source and message fields.

tools.name: economic_calendar_list_countries
tools.description: Returns the list of countries available in the MetaTrader 5 Economic Calendar, including each country’s identifier, name, code, currency, and related metadata when available. Optionally filters countries by currency, country code, or a case-insensitive search term. When multiple filters are supplied, all filters are combined using AND. This tool is read-only and does not modify terminal state, calendar data, or trading activity.

country_code.description: Optional ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 Economic Calendar country code (use special code EU for European Union and WW for Worldwide), case-insensitive.

country_id.description: Optional Economic Calendar country id. Required non-negative unsigned integer represented as a decimal string. When supplied, returns only the country with this exact ID.

currency_code.description: Optional ISO 4217 three-letter currency code (use special code ALL for Worldwide), used to filter countries, case-insensitive.

filter.description: Optional case-insensitive substring applied to country name, country code, currency code and url_name.

tools.name: economic_calendar_list_events_by_country
tools.description: Returns the list of event descriptions available in the MetaTrader 5 Economic Calendar by country code. Each item describes an event series, such as CPI m/m or Nonfarm Payrolls; it is not a dated calendar release and does not contain actual, forecast or previous values. This tool is read-only and does not modify terminal state, calendar data, or trading activity.

country_code.description: Exact ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 Economic Calendar country code (use special code EU for European Union and WW for Worldwide), case-insensitive.

tools.name: economic_calendar_list_events_by_currency
tools.description: Returns the list of event descriptions available in the MetaTrader 5 Economic Calendar by currency code. Each item describes an event series, such as CPI m/m or Nonfarm Payrolls; it is not a dated calendar release and does not contain actual, forecast or previous values. Broad queries such as ALL may return a large unpaginated catalog. This tool is read-only and does not modify terminal state, calendar data, or trading activity.

currency_code.description: Exact ISO 4217 three-letter currency code (use special code ALL for Worldwide), used to filter countries, case-insensitive.

tools.name: economic_calendar_list_values
tools.description: Returns the list of event values available in the MetaTrader 5 Economic Calendar for a datetime range. Datetime range values are interpreted as trade-server time. This tool is read-only and does not modify terminal state, calendar data, or trading activity.

datetime_from.description: Inclusive start time as ISO datetime. Supply a timezone-free datetime interpreted in the current trade-server timezone.

datetime_to.description: Exclusive end time as ISO datetime. Must be greater than datetime_from. Supply a timezone-free datetime interpreted in the current trade-server timezone.

event_id.description: Optional Economic Calendar event id used to filter values. Required positive unsigned 64-bit integer represented as a decimal string.

limit.description: Maximum number of records to return. 1000 by default.

tools.name: economic_calendar_list_values_last
tools.description: Returns the list of event values available in the MetaTrader 5 Economic Calendar since the calendar database status with a specified change_id. Provide zero value for change_id to get the current change_id of the calendar database. This tool is read-only and does not modify terminal state, calendar data, or trading activity.

change_id.description: Economic Calendar database change ID. Provide zero value for change_id to get only the current change_id of the calendar database without list of events. Required non-negative unsigned 64-bit integer represented as a decimal string.

event_id.description: Optional Economic Calendar event id used to filter values. Required positive unsigned 64-bit integer represented as a decimal string.

tools.name: economic_calendar_get_value_by_id
tools.description: Returns one dated MetaTrader 5 Economic Calendar event value by its id. The value_id is not an event description id. This tool is read-only and does not modify terminal state, calendar data, or trading activity.

value_id.description: Exact Economic Calendar event value id. Required positive unsigned 64-bit integer represented as a decimal string.

tools.name: economic_calendar_get_event_by_id
tools.description: Returns one MetaTrader 5 Economic Calendar event description by its id. This does not return a dated release or actual, forecast, and previous values. This tool is read-only and does not modify terminal state, calendar data, or trading activity.

event_id.description: Exact Economic Calendar event id. Required positive unsigned 64-bit integer represented as a decimal string.
